## Code review

CodeRabbit does not review pull requests automatically. Request a review when
the PR is ready by commenting on it:

- `@coderabbitai review` reviews the commits pushed since its last review.
- `@coderabbitai full review` reviews the whole PR from scratch.
- `@coderabbitai resolve` resolves every comment it left.
- `@coderabbitai help` lists the other commands.

A `request changes` review from CodeRabbit blocks merging until it is
addressed and re-requested, so request it before asking a maintainer to look.
